Here is an overview of the domain corresponding to point 4: Domain 4: Warehouse and Inventory Management Introduction: The warehouse and inventory management domain involves managing the storage, movement, and tracking of materials, goods, and spare parts in a circular knitting factory. Use cases: * Warehouses management: This involves managing multiple warehouses and storage locations and tracking inventory levels to ensure there is enough stock to meet production and customer demands. * Product & Services catalogs: This includes managing the catalog of available products and services, such as different types of yarn or fabrics, that are used in the production process. * Inventory: This involves tracking the inventory levels of raw materials, goods, spare parts, and wastes in the warehouse, as well as monitoring raw material usage and inventory levels. * Inventory transactions and movements: This involves managing inventory transactions and movements, such as receipt and issue of materials, as well as tracking warehouse handling and maintaining a Kardex of materials and goods. * Dispatch & Shipment: This includes managing the dispatch of orders and tracking the shipment and delivery of finished goods to customers, as well as handling customer complaints and returns. Features: * Multiple warehouse management * Catalog management for products and services * Inventory tracking and monitoring * Inventory transactions and movement management * Dispatch and shipment management * Customer complaint and return handling * Kardex management for materials and goods Overall, this domain is critical for ensuring that the circular knitting factory has the necessary materials and goods to support production and meet customer demands, as well as efficiently managing the warehouse operations and inventory movements.
